name: AI
body: Most folks bring their own AI provider API key to power Metabase's AI features. If you use our AI service, it is billed per token.
included: 1 million tokens to get you started

name: Transforms
body: Transforms run on a schedule against your data. Self-hosting gives you unlimited transforms, since they run on your own infrastructure.

name: Advanced transforms
body: Just like regular transforms, with the heavier work billed at a higher rate once the included runs are used up.

name: Storage
body: Optional, for when your data is not already in a database and you would rather upload spreadsheets or CSVs to analyse in Metabase.
